# netbox_front_port_templates (Data Source)

Lists NetBox front port template objects (`/api/dcim/front-port-templates/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_front_port_templates" "all" {}

data "netbox_front_port_templates" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "front_port_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_front_port_templates.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/front-port-templates/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `module_type_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type (`netbox_module_type`).
- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.
- `positions` (Number) Positions. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes List) Rear Ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--rear_ports))
- `type` (String) Type. One of 63 valid NetBox choices (see the NetBox documentation).
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--items--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.rear_ports`

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) Position.
- `rear_port` (Number) Rear Port.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Rear Port Position.
